encounter.reason: Severe Refractory Atopic Dermatitis with extreme IgE elevation

documents.title: Allergy & Immunology Progress Note
documents.content:
**Patient:** Mateo, 36yo cis female.

**Condition:** Severe Refractory Atopic Dermatitis with extreme IgE elevation.

**HPI:** Patient presents with persistent, debilitating pruritus, marked by scratching and scaling.  Significant IgE levels (1600 IU/mL) are noted, indicative of a prolonged inflammatory response.  Skin examination reveals extensive lichenification and erosions.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient is warm to touch, exhibiting significant pruritus localized to the dorsal aspect of the extremities. Skin appears dry and fragile with minimal erythema. No evidence of secondary infection.

**Management Plan:** Initiate dupilumab therapy at prescribed dose. Monitor IgE levels weekly for response. Consider adjunctive topical corticosteroids and moisturizers as needed.

diagnostics.conclusion: Total Serum Immunoglobulin E (IgE) abnormal findings: Severe Refractory Atopic Dermatitis with extreme IgE elevation. Key indicators: total IgE > 1600 IU/mL, severe pruritus.
